children.name: copy / instrumentCaption
children.text: The OLED shows firmware output. Control inputs inject recorded GPIO, ADC and UART paths; pressure and audio remain incomplete.

children.name: copy / formatNote
children.text: APP1 starts at the application handoff. Full flash starts at resident entry. ROM and DCD execution are not included.

children.name: copy / traceNote
children.text: JSON with firmware identity, execution and model limits.

children.name: copy / controlNote
children.text: Hold a pad with a pointer, Enter or Space. These injected levels test firmware input paths; they do not reproduce physical velocity or calibrated pressure.

children.name: copy / inputNote
children.text: For buttons, 1 is held and 0 is released. Knob and pad values are normalized model inputs.

children.name: copy / usbNote
children.text: Send a 64-byte hexadecimal HID report to this session’s emulated firmware, or read its current USB status. USB support depends on the loaded build and the peripheral model.

children.name: copy / introduction
children.text: Load a firmware file from your computer. Run independent sessions to compare builds, inspect execution and exchange virtual USB reports.

children.name: copy / researchLimit
children.text: Research build. Peripheral coverage is incomplete. Results here need separate hardware verification for boot, recovery, audio and firmware updates.

children.name: copy / localNote
children.text: Firmware stays in this browser. The runtime downloads when you press Start. This page has no connection to a physical SP.
